title: Executive Briefing & One-pager for Q3 Roadmap Review
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Purpose: Produce a concise executive one-pager and a 12-slide deck for the Q3 roadmap review (monthly exec readout + board packet appendix). The deliverables must clearly surface: 1) key wins vs prior quarter (metrics + anecdotes), 2) major initiatives and alignment to OKRs, 3) current risks and mitigation plans, 4) ask (decisions, budget, headcount), and 5) success metrics for the next quarter. Audience: CEO, CPO, Board members, VP Eng, Sales leadership, Head of Customer Success.

Scope: Focus on cross-functional initiatives that materially impact inference economics and reliability: Dedicated autoscaling improvements, KV cache persistence pilot, Console rollout for per-route cost transparency, and Private deployment GA roadmap. Include a 2-line summary for each initiative, top-level timeline (Gantt-style), owners, and dependencies. Call out any production escalations or SLO regressions that affect executive risk assessment.

Data sources: Redwood Console dashboards (latency, cost per 1k tokens), Segment for adoption funnels, Stripe revenue snapshots, Dedicated capacity SLA incidents (incidents-2026-Q1), and user research highlight quotes.

Deliverable format: 1-page PDF one-pager and a 12-slide Google Slides deck. Also attach a Confluence appendix with raw metrics and links to related PRs and RFCs.

Key success criteria: Execs can read the one-pager in under 5 minutes and leave the meeting with clear yes/no decisions on two asks: (A) additional Dedicated capacity commit approval, (B) green light on private deploy GA timeline.

Risks: blockers on ENG-4132 kernel scheduling work, delayed benchmarking data for quantized models (ENG-4201), and outstanding design signoff on Console UX for the cost breakdown (DES-214). Mitigations are listed in updates below.
updates: 2026-03-01: Kickoff meeting with stakeholders. Aligned on audience and 3 primary asks. Assigned slide leads: Marco (roadmap summary), Priya (metrics + console), Kelsey (eng risks). Action: gather P0 metrics by 2026-03-08.

2026-03-04: First draft of slide deck started. Pulled latency and cost charts from Console: latency_p50 and cost_per_1k_tokens. Noted an anomaly in Dedicated pool throughput on 2026-02-20; opened ENG incident tracker reference INCIDENT-768.

2026-03-06: Engineering update: ENG-4132 (kernel scheduling) now has a merged RFC but benchmarking delayed due to infra flakiness. Contingency slide prepared describing phased rollout instead of immediate GA. Owner: Kelsey. ETA for stable benchmark: 2026-03-18.
2026-03-07: Design review: DES-214 provided alternative cost-breakdown visuals; design asks for one extra day for polish. Decision: include simplified waterfall as fallback. Designer: Nina Gomez.

2026-03-08: Metrics compilation complete. Key wins: 12% reduction in median token cost from caching optimizations; Dedicated throughput improved by 8% after kernel hotfix. Added customer quote from Acme Health on lower inference latency. Links added to raw dashboards and experiment PRs.
2026-03-09: Draft deck shared with execs (link below). Requested feedback by 2026-03-11 EOD. Noted specific ask from CFO to include 3-year cost model scenario; assigned to Omar for numbers.

2026-03-10: Received initial exec feedback: simplify technical deep-dive slides and expand the ask language on capacity commit. Updated one-pager to emphasize decision points. Action items created for follow-up: CFO numbers (Omar), Benchmarks (Kelsey), Slide polish (Nina).
acceptance_criteria: One-pager PDF finalized and uploaded to Confluence at /confluence/roadmap/q3-exec-onepager by 2026-03-14
